name: Grafana Cloud
description: Search/execute over the grafana.com Cloud API (stacks, orgs, access policies, tokens, regions, stack plugins), catalog from the OpenAPI spec grafana.com publishes.

org.help: The slug in your grafana.com address: https://grafana.com/orgs/<slug>.

token.help: A Cloud access policy token (glc_…). Sent as Authorization: Bearer.

apiUrl.help: Leave empty for https://grafana.com/api. Must use https.

specUrl.help: Leave empty to fetch the spec from grafana.com, falling back to the copy in grafana/grafana-com-public-clients on GitHub. Set a mirror of openapi.json if this server can reach neither. Must use https.

connection.help:
1. On grafana.com, open **Administration → Users and access → Cloud access policies** and create a policy in your org realm with the least scopes Synoikia needs: `orgs:read`, `stacks:read`, `stack-plugins:read` and `accesspolicies:read` to read; add `:write` and `:delete` scopes only for what it should change.
2. Add a token to that policy.
3. Enter your organization slug and the token, then **Test connection**: it reads the org and fetches the API spec.

The catalog comes from the spec grafana.com publishes at `/api/openapi.json`. When grafana.com does not serve it, the copy in `grafana/grafana-com-public-clients` on GitHub is used.
